out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CFM will post the 2026 food permit.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Cheese cake, tres leches, tres leches, tiramisu in unit # 4 at 48, 49, 49, 49F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Cheese cake, tres leches, tres leches, tiramisu

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed multiple squeeze bottles without name.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label all squeeze bottles and seasoning containers. JOE & PIE PIZZERIA VA (Inspection Date: 06/30/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door. Opening observed lower right side the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Repair the door and install an effective door sweep or framing to eliminate pest entry

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: The diameter of the air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the @EQUIPMENT@ is less than twice the diameter of the water supply inlet. Observed sanitizer basin without the air gap
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CFM will provide an air gap for the sanitizer basin

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling is not maintained in good repair. Ceiling observed with gaps.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Seal all openings and maintain the ceiling in good repair to prevent pest entry and provide smooth, cleanable surfaces
